answer: Every identity begins as a plume-sealed parcel handed over at a departure desk: the same body must carry it, unopened, along one named public voyage within the same epoch to an arrival desk, where a warden breaks the seal and matches the cipher inside to the departure record. One body carries one parcel per voyage, and the k-th identity from one household rides a route of k legs, each stamped by a new warden. Forging 1,000 puppets needs 1+2+…+1000 = 500,500 legs at about $15 a leg, $7,507,500 in fares; one honest user pays one $15 fare for a single leg.
